# Skiper106 Smooth Caret

Enable this local plugin in Settings > Community plugins, then restart Obsidian. It uses a bundled spring overlay for Markdown editors, native text inputs and textareas, and editable text such as note titles. The old skiper106 CSS snippet is disabled to avoid double animation.

Reduced motion, forced colors, selections, and IME composition retain native caret behavior. Input types without a browser selection API, such as number and date controls, retain their native caret.

Based on https://skiper-ui.com/v1/skiper106 by gxuri. Motion is bundled locally; no network access is required.
